column1: # Purpose: Track due-diligence findings with severity

column4: Hardcoded default auth token in VM console path
column10: AUTH_TOKEN defaults to changeme and is wired through default runtime config
column17: Insecure default remained in production path
column18: Require explicit token input and fail-fast configuration validation

column4: Hardcoded default auth token in host gateway
column10: CLI default auth token is changeme and remains valid without mandatory override
column17: Convenience CLI default bypassed security posture
column18: Reject startup without explicit auth config outside test mode

column4: Auth token material logged during console auth failure paths
column10: Reject logs include raw auth bytes/token-adjacent material
column17: Sensitive bytes emitted in diagnostic logs
column18: Introduce structured redaction helper and negative log assertions

column4: Regression pack failure in shard script policy flow
column10: cargo test -p tests fails: failed to walk to /actions/queue
column17: Fixture assumptions diverged from policy namespace behavior
column18: Lock fixture contracts to manifest gates and add regression fixture guard

column4: Workspace test gate fails due to sel4-runtime section spec on macOS
column10: cargo test --workspace fails with Mach-O invalid section specifier for .data
column17: Section annotations assumed ELF across targets
column18: Add target-aware section attribute wrapper with macOS CI coverage

column4: Docs hash drift in TEST_PLAN manifest fingerprint
column10: scripts/check-generated.sh fails: expected hash differs from manifest hash
column18: Require scripted snippet refresh in pre-merge checklist

column4: Contributor guidance uses non-runnable coh-rtc command
column10: coh-rtc requires mandatory args but docs require bare cargo run -p coh-rtc
column17: Documentation command example drifted from actual CLI contract
column18: Add docs command smoke checks in CI

column4: Regression batch script previously forced non-SMP seL4 build path despite SMP test precondition
column10: Hardcoded $HOME/seL4/build removed; script now resolves SEL4_BUILD_DIR with SMP default and validates build directory before launch
column17: Script encoded developer-local path and bypassed documented SMP default
column18: Centralize build-dir resolution on env override plus repo SMP default and keep syntax checks in gate

column4: sel4-sys affinity invocation label is not cfg-gated for non-SMP kernel headers
column10: Build fails when invocation_label_TCBSetAffinity is absent in selected seL4 headers
column17: Bindings assume affinity label availability across kernel configurations
column18: Gate wrapper generation on kernel config/header feature detection

column4: REST gateway exposes control-plane writes without per-request authentication
column10: Any client reaching /v1/fs/echo can trigger state.write using service-attached role/ticket
column17: Route handlers trust process-level credentials without caller authn
column18: Add request authentication middleware and deny non-loopback exposure by default

column4: TEST_PLAN Python commands are not portable to hosts with python3-only path
column10: Plan uses python but environment provides python3; pytest step cannot execute as written
column17: Command examples did not reflect toolchain baseline
column18: Normalize docs commands to python3 and add lint for executable examples

column4: TEST_PLAN omits workspace and tests-crate gates used to detect active regressions
column10: Host test list excludes cargo test -p tests and cargo test --workspace despite active failures there
column17: Test plan drifted from enforced CI gate set
column18: Derive test-plan required commands from gate script to prevent divergence

column4: Hardcoded default auth token in coh CLI fallback
column10: resolve_auth_token falls back to literal changeme when CLI/env token is unset
column17: Convenience fallback token remained in production CLI path
column18: Require explicit auth token input or environment in non-mock mode

column4: Hardcoded default auth token in cohsh CLI fallback
column10: CLI default auth token remains changeme when no override is provided
column17: Client startup path preserves insecure default token
column18: Fail fast when token is unset and gate legacy default behind explicit dev mode

column4: Hardcoded default auth token in cohsh TCP transport builder
column10: CohshTransportBuilder initializes auth_token with literal changeme and test flows rely on the same value
column17: Transport defaults prioritized convenience over secret hygiene
column18: Initialize builder with empty token and require explicit configuration before connect
